mysticism.race.attuned_wyrm.description: An elemental wyrm that has yet to discover which element will shape its evolution, the Attuned Wyrm wanders in search of a path forward. Its affinity remains unsettled, leaving its potential open but its abilities unrefined. Each encounter with elemental forces may bring it closer to awakening a nature—and power—uniquely its own.
mysticism.race.forgotten.description: A soul left outside the cycle of reincarnation, the Forgotten survives as a remnant of a life that has ended. Memories fade, leaving fragments of its former identity and an uneasy presence between worlds. Neither truly alive nor fully gone, it wanders in search of meaning, a past it can reclaim, or release at last.
mysticism.race.insect.description: Known in the Cardinal World as Insectars, these insectoid monsters possess varied bodies and specialized abilities shaped by their kind. Their hard shells and formidable strength make them natural combatants, while distinct lineages excel in different roles. &7&oSelecting this race rerolls your species among those enabled in Mysticism's General configuration.&r
mysticism.race.lesser_angel.description: A low-ranking spiritual life-form of light, the Lesser Angel serves as a foot soldier in the angelic host. It descends to the Cardinal World during recurring invasions, arriving under higher command every five centuries. Though its ego and power are less developed than a Greater Angel's, it remains resilient, disciplined, and dangerous in numbers.
mysticism.race.phantom.description: Born in the Underworld from the magicules of Veldora, the World-Destroying Dragon, Phantoms are demi-spiritual beings with bodies between substance and spirit. They thrive amid dense magicules and can wield supernatural powers beyond ordinary monsters. Those who develop an ego may rise through the ranks of the Phantom army, gaining individuality and greater strength.
mysticism.race.restricted_human.descript: A human born with a Heavenly Restriction, a binding condition that trades one aspect of the self for extraordinary physical gifts. With little or no magicule capacity, this race relies on heightened senses, speed, and strength instead of spellcraft. Mastery of weapons and tactical awareness can make a Restricted Human dangerous even to powerful monsters.
mysticism.race.sculk_worm.description: The Sculk Worm was born in the Overworld, far from the Sift, where its kind once lived freely, happily, and sang together. Here, the world's corruption reshaped its nature; sculk now spreads through its body, leaving it attuned to darkness and sound. It begins as a fragile creature, but adaptation can make it terrifying.
mysticism.race.divine_army_wasp.descript: This divinely empowered Army Wasp commands attention. Encountering one is dangerous; you may not make it out in one piece.
